newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end firmer after moving narrowly.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end firmer after moving narrowly.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended marginally firmer on Wednesday after wandering narrowly in both positive and negative territory for most of the day, brokers said.
They said most investors were on the sidelines due to a lack of incentives to buy, despite the Dow's overnight rise to a record high.
The 225-issue Nikkei average closed 35.63 points or 0.17 percent higher at 21,498.60. Its December futures were up 10 points at 21,510.
"The U.S. market set a new record high overnight but the impact of the bullishness was limited in Tokyo," said Keiji Arai, deputy general manager at Sanyo Securities.
